meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通读代码库中的每个源文件,大文件分页读取,并基于读到的内容继续工作。
howto.when: 当你说“learn the codebase”“read the codebase”“get up to speed”等指令,或开始接手新/不熟悉的项目时触发。

say.note: Claude 会开始通读所有源码

say.text: 把代码库从头到尾读一遍
say.note: 它会分页读完每个文件

say.text: 刚接手这个项目,帮我熟悉一下代码
say.note: 触发对新项目的代码通读

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will read every source file in the codebase in full, paging through large files, to build an understanding of the code for future work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when asked to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", or "get up to speed".

say_en.note: Claude will read all source files.

say_en.text: Read the entire codebase from top to bottom.
I'm new to this project; get familiar with the code.
